params.title: Executive Summary
params.content:
This document consolidates the results of the penetration tests conducted on the component **{{team}}/{{component}}**, as requested by {{requester}}, performed in the **{{environment}}** environment by the {{author}} team on {{date}}.

During the tests, **{{finding_count}}** vulnerabilities were identified, classified according to their criticality and potential impact on the evaluated assets. The detected findings include: {{finding_types}}, which are technically detailed in the subsequent sections of this report, along with mitigation and remediation recommendations.

This report aims to provide technical management and security governance with a clear view of the identified risks, as well as support strategic decisions to strengthen the organization's security posture.
